cards.title: AI demand survives; risk premium rises
cards.question: Is this a price reset or an earnings reset?
cards.selfCheck: FACT: Nasdaq lost 3.4% Nov 2–6, fourth down week; >10% off peak. Oct followed Sept AI optimism; Aug rate/oil stress preceded it. TEST: earnings revisions and SOXX relative strength. Falling orders reject the valuation-only thesis.
cards.prompt: Separate 7/30/90-day AI demand evidence from equity multiple compression. Sources: Reuters Nov 6 2026 https://www.reuters.com/business/nasdaq-futures-rise-after-steep-ai-selloff-chip-stocks-stabilize-2026-11-06/ and Reuters Sep 21 2026.

cards.title: A bounce needs breadth, not just chips
cards.question: Are investors rebuilding risk or rotating defensively?
cards.selfCheck: FACT: Nov 6 chip index +4.2% but S&P -2.7% for week; Nov 9 Citi cut US equities to neutral on AI positioning. WATCH: RSP/SPY, IWM, XBI, credit spreads and 10Y. Broad participation with stable credit supports repair.
cards.prompt: Build a 2-week breadth and credit confirmation framework using Reuters Nov 6 and Nov 9 2026: https://www.reuters.com/business/citigroup-downgrades-us-equities-neutral-ai-concerns-2026-11-09/

cards.title: Bandwidth matters; ROI decides
cards.question: Can AI suppliers grow while customers curb capex?
cards.selfCheck: FACT: NVIDIA's Feb 25 Rubin announcement targeted lower inference token costs; recent AMD data-center growth supports demand. HYPOTHESIS: MU/HBM and optical benefit from efficiency shifts. TEST: qualified supply, order visibility, actual cost/token and customer cash flow.
cards.prompt: Trace memory bandwidth, KV cache, optics and cost per token to MU, NVDA, AMD, COHR and CRDO; distinguish company claims from deployed economics. NVIDIA Feb 25 2026 investor release https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-2026/

cards.title: Rubin promise meets the power grid
cards.question: Will announced 2026 platforms become utilized 2027 capacity?
cards.selfCheck: FACT: NVIDIA announced Rubin and named initial cloud adopters Feb 25, 2026. HYPOTHESIS: 2027 deployment boosts GPU, networking and HBM revenue. WATCH: rack shipments, power-on dates, utilization and capex-to-cash conversion. Delays reject timing.
cards.prompt: Build a dated deployment scorecard for NVIDIA Rubin, hyperscaler cloud instances and power constraints. Primary: https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-2026/

cards.title: 2027 budgets will test AI returns
cards.question: What would 2027 capex plans reveal about real demand?
cards.selfCheck: WINDOW: Nov 2026–Q2 2027 earnings, guidance and deployment updates. BULL: utilization and cloud revenue grow faster than capex; BEAR: delayed sites, financing stress or weaker orders. WATCH NVDA, AMZN, MSFT, MU and power suppliers.
cards.prompt: Construct bull/base/bear scenarios for 2027 cloud budgets and commissioning, using quarterly primary earnings releases; do not assume unverified event dates.

cards.title: Strong suppliers should separate
cards.question: Will funded suppliers outperform leveraged builders by Dec 9?
cards.selfCheck: HYPOTHESIS: diversified MU/semicap/optical basket beats CRWV/NBIS-like capital-intensive operators over 30 days if orders hold. REJECT: supplier guidance cuts or no relative outperformance with stable credit. Compare equal-weight baskets, not one volatile day.
cards.prompt: Define a 30-day equal-weight relative return test with entry baseline Nov 9 close, credit spreads, estimate revisions and explicit invalidation.
